author: GrantInPhoenix
body:
IGN : iTerraCubist
Reason why i was Temp-Banned: Combat Logging (Banned from April 12-19)
Reason why i should be unbanned:
- Because i have/get really bad or not even close to decent connection to the server
causing me to lag via client-side and i can't control my connection/ping to the server
of course since 1, im from asia (Philippines; we merely don't get the good internet in our
country) 2, emphasis to my internet, its not as stable so there are times where before i
login it would show atleast 250-300+ ping on average, and more than half the time
i get the usual average of 400-1000+ ping (since my connection to the server is
very unstable) so when im in combat, 90% of the time i timeout/ disconnect since my
connection with the servers host ends from my client/internet, and the other 10% i
relog/logout and refresh the connection, i don't intentionally to logout while in combat/
combat log but w/ my connection to the server being unstable, there are a couple or so
instances where i am forced to relog myself manually rather than timeout and refresh
(like when the game has no movement client-side and lags for more than 30 seconds to
2 mins)

here is proof of my ms/ping/connection to the server
(also note that since my connection is unstable, there are times where before i login it
says like 250-300 ping, but when i login and im in the server it drops to 400-1000 ping)
http://prntscr.com/74rzz3 
http://prntscr.com/74rznj
http://prntscr.com/74rtpn 
http://prntscr.com/74rw9a 
http://prntscr.com/74rr7v 
http://prntscr.com/74rrkj 
http://prntscr.com/74rx7c 
http://prntscr.com/74ryw5 
http://prntscr.com/74rwnd 
http://prntscr.com/74ry4v 
http://prntscr.com/74rxmd

I hope for the best that this ban appeal shall be approved by the mods and sr mods or admins!

replies.body: Just to add to this, every time someone knocked you out of the world, you "apparently" disconnected, which in my opinion is hard to believe.
